context: Collect a bounded recent window of develop merges and Develop PR required-gate durations from GitHub Actions. Re-query live required contexts. Count shadow_eligible versus full_required on recent synchronize events. Write an audit or decision under _project/ that states whether gate duration is a material fraction of interarrival, what open-time currency (01) cannot fix, and which one of keep-SHADOW_ONLY / consider-07a / consider-07b is justified. Queueing cost of multi-PR refresh must be priced.
description: Produce a measurement-backed record of whether a serialized strict-base repo can converge. Compare required-gate wall-clock (ci-required-result, especially medium-test) to develop merge interarrival and to live refresh-shadow eligible yield. This item may recommend keeping SHADOW_ONLY, or may recommend that an operator later reopen 07a or 07b. It must not itself unblock 07a/07b, change skip conditions, or mutate GitHub settings.

anti_patterns.dont: Recommend updating every open PR on each develop merge
anti_patterns.instead: price that cost explicitly if any updater is considered
anti_patterns.why: refresh storm is already documented as self-defeating

anti_patterns.dont: Treat open-time currency as sufficient if gate duration approaches interarrival
anti_patterns.instead: report both open-stale residual and in-flight interarrival residual separately
anti_patterns.why: refreshing at open still loses to a merge that lands during the next full gate

anti_patterns.instead: write a recommendation and leave a later activation TODO to consume it
anti_patterns.why: 06 is still the activation authority; this item only produces evidence

preserves.behavior: 07a and 07b remain blocked unless a later activation item, not this one, unblocks them
No required check is skipped from this measurement

prior_art.concept: historical refresh replay and shadow_eligible yield
whole-event latency and medium-test as merge-unblock wall

verifications.description: Measurement record states sample, gate duration, interarrival, and a single recommendation

verifications.command: _project/scripts/todo show strict-base-refresh-07a-reduced-fast-refresh-rollout --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get("blocked_reason")'
verifications.description: 07a remains blocked after this item exists

work_units.evidence: Live ruleset 15611785 strict=true; 07a/07b blocked; 10/10 recent shadow runs full_required
work_units.summary: Revalidate live required contexts, shadow workflow, and 07a/07b blocked state
Measure required-gate wall-clock and develop merge interarrival on a stated sample
Count live shadow_eligible yield and record fail-closed reasons
Write the measurement record with a single recommendation and residual risk
